### Session Abstract & Key Takeaways

"Zero Trust" in Multi-Cluster K8s: Cryptographic Workload Identity with SPIRE & Cilium!

How do we eliminate long-lived API tokens and static service account secrets?
This session dives deep into:
- Mutual TLS handshake mechanics with SPIFFE IDs
- Dynamic x509 SVID issuance and rotation under 30s
- Practical troubleshooting for eBPF kernel tracing
